_comment: Individual guest reviews (Google, Trustpilot, TripAdvisor). id is preserved EXACTLY from the historical Prisma reviews.id this data was migrated from on 2026-08-19 (one-time export — 217 rows, script not retained since it was a single-use migration aid; see git history of this file for the commit that added it) — jvto-web's /why-jvto/reviews/{id} route and the #review-{id} JSON-LD @id both bake this integer into public, possibly-indexed URLs, so it must never be renumbered. nextId tracks the next integer to assign to a newly-synced Google review; Trustpilot/TripAdvisor have no automated sync (none existed before this migration either) and are updated manually here going forward, same as before. packageAttribution marks the 19 records whose packageSlug was DERIVED from the review text (destinations named, trip length, pick-up/drop-off city, matched against each product's itinerary, name and paid add-ons) rather than captured with the booking. Absence of the field means the slug came with the record. Reviews that name no destination, or whose named combination fits more than one product, were deliberately left unattributed — see docs/review-package-attribution.md.

Our tour guide Gufron - was super friendly and made sure all our needs were taken care off...his knowledge of the area was also great. Our drive Joyo knows how to get from A to B in the fastest time possible! We did the 5/6 night tour but in hindsight the 4/5 night tour would have given us all the highlights of the region. Prior to departing from Singapore, the operator said that hiking poles would be provided and we didn’t need to bring ours. On the morning of the hike when we were finally at the lodge, Boy said that the hiking poles were broken and that we’d have to hike without them. This was despite him claiming the night before that he was going to prepare our hiking equipment. During the hike, he also accidentally revealed that he actually went to a night market the evening before instead, and kept saying he was feeling sleepy because of that. Don’t think that’s very professional nor safe.

(Translated by Google) I participated in a tour of Java's Mount Ijen Volcano, Mount Bromo, and Madakaripura Waterfall. The comprehensive outdoor plan included airport transfers, meals, accommodation, and a guide. Our accommodation, Riverside Homestay, even had a pool, making for a truly enjoyable stay. The tour features a highly efficient and reliable system, with the driver and guide contacting each other in advance and accompanied by photos. Both our driver, Freddy, and the mountain guide boy were cheerful and helpful, helping with photography and accommodating even the smallest of requests. Each of the three tourist sites was truly worthy of being called the main event. With some motorbike travel and river fording, the tour was packed with extraordinary experiences. There were also opportunities to sample local fruit, and the opportunity to ride a horse for just 3,000 yen—exceptional experiences unimaginable in Japan. The only thing I noticed was that the accommodation on the second day was a little noisy. Furthermore, the roads are narrow in all locations, and Mount Bromo in particular is filled with jeeps, making it difficult for beginners to stop or make U-turns. For this reason, we recommend hiring a guide. Considering accommodation, meals, transportation, photography assistance, etc., the service is exceptionally good for this price, so we highly recommend it.
In particular, the driving involved a six-hour round trip from the airport, as well as nighttime transportation and guiding, so we were grateful to Freddie, who accompanied us with a smile until the very end despite the hard work.

Be careful, even if that is not specific to this tour, there is a lot of transportation hours during the weekend (we spent 16 hours in the car in total in only two days). Our only regret is that we had a friend who couldn't do the trek part after he had a pain in the leg, and our guide told us he would arrange for him to join us in Bromo, and in fact it could have been absolutely feasible to pick him with a motorbike. Instead he had to stay in the car for 5 hours. Same for the next day, it could have been possible to pick him and go to the hot springs. Another negative point is the dinner on Saturday night which was disappointing and too small after a big day of activity, and that no food is offered on Sunday after the trek.

Booked a 4D3N tour with JVTO, covering Tumpak Sewu, Mount Bromo, Madakaripura Waterfall and Ijen, and it was truly such a fun and memorable experience. Every destination was breathtaking, and although the early mornings were tough, waking up to admire the night sky and catch the sunrise was definitely worth it.

A special mention to our driver, Fredi, who was an excellent and highly reliable driver. We always felt safe and comfortable with him behind the wheel, where we could even fall asleep peacefully during the long drives.

Another special mention to our guide, Juan, who was incredibly helpful and attentive to our needs. He was such a fun person to be around and was always ready to lend a hand whenever we needed one. His friendly personality definitely made the trip even more enjoyable.

All in all, the trip was filled with beautiful sights, fun experiences and unforgettable memories, made even better by having such wonderful guides accompanying us along the way. We truly had a great time and would not hesitate to book another trip with JVTO in the future.
